fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2026-01-05, a group of persons allegedly attacked the complainant at Amudham Nagar Main Street, causing injuries that required treatment. The time of the incident was given as 21:00 on 2026-01-05. The complaint was lodged by Sanjay Raj (9000000083). A witness, Padmini Raj, reachable on 9000000032, was mentioned in the complaint. Vasanth Mani (9000000382), described as a neighbour, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complainant alleged that Sanjay Velan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000095. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Group allegedly confronted the victim following an earlier dispute.
fields.Keywords: group assault, injury, associate, witness, suspect, night, mobile number, main street
